# **I. Overall Requirements**

## **1\. Context Diagram**

**HeavenStay Wellness Resort Management System (HSWRMS)** is an integrated platform for wellness retreat booking, accommodation operations, spa/therapy scheduling, personalized nutrition, consolidated billing, analytics, and permission-controlled administration. It connects guests and resort staff with external payment, calendar, email, and identity services.

![][image2]

[HSWRMS\_Context\_diagram](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Miv4dCiSy9jktNjG99GeY-12BL2J8_Rh/view?usp=sharing)

*Figure 1\. HSWRMS system context diagram* 

**System boundary rationale.** Guest, Receptionist, Therapist, F\&B Staff/Chef, Admin and Manager are external human actors because they initiate or receive business interactions with AWRMS. VNPay, Calendar & Notification Services, and Google/Facebook Identity Providers remain outside the system boundary because AWRMS consumes their services rather than implementing those external platforms.

## **2\. Main Business Flow**

### **2.1 Customer Onboarding & Wellness Profile Setup (BF-01)** 

**Primary Module:** M1 \- Authentication & Sensitive Health Profile

**Primary Actors / Systems:** Customer, Admin, HSWRMS, Google Identity Providers, Email Notification Service

**Trigger:** A new Customer wants to create an account and use HSWRMS.

**End Condition:** The Customer has a verified account and a valid Dietary & Health Profile that can be securely used by authorized resort services.

***![][image3]***

### [**Link Customer Onboarding & Wellness Profile Setup (BF-01)**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DKSB-TKV_4p30yWvE_OQcPJRKdyiruzd/view?usp=drive_link)  {#link-customer-onboarding-&-wellness-profile-setup-(bf-01)}

### **2.2 Retreat Booking, Deposit & Check-In (BF-02)** 

**Primary Module:** M2 \- Retreat Package & Accommodation Booking

**Primary Actors / Systems:** Customer, Receptionist, HSWRMS, VNPay Payment Gateway

**Trigger:** An authenticated Customer wants to book a wellness retreat.

**End Condition:** The retreat booking is confirmed, required deposit is successfully paid, and the Customer is checked in with an assigned physical villa.

***![][image4]***

### **2.3 Spa/Therapy Scheduling & Session Fulfillment (BF-03)** 

**Primary Module:** M3 \- Spa & Therapy Scheduling (CORE)

**Primary Actors / Systems:** Customer, Receptionist, Spa Therapist / Yoga Instructor, HSWRMS, Calendar & Notification Services

**Trigger:** A Customer or Receptionist requests a Spa/Therapy session.

**End Condition:** The session has been confirmed and fulfilled, and its final status is recorded as **Completed** or **No-Show**.

![][image5]

[Link Spa/Therapy Scheduling & Session Fulfillment (BF-03)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Y1LweOIPHEEtrGGs8kjUfsDsEAukAauL/view?usp=sharing)

### **2.4 Personalized Dining & F\&B Service Fulfillment (BF-04)**  {#2.4-personalized-dining-&-f&b-service-fulfillment-(bf-04)}

**Primary Module:** M4 \- Dietary F\&B Management

**Primary Actors / Systems:** Customer, Chef / F\&B Staff, HSWRMS(System)

**Trigger:** A Customer wants to select or order a meal during the retreat.

**End Condition:** The meal has been prepared/fulfilled and any additional F\&B charge has been recorded in the Customer Folio.![][image6]

[Link Personalized F\&B Flow (BF-04)](https://online.visual-paradigm.com/share.jsp?id=343731353533332d31)

### **2.5 Consolidated Checkout, Payment & Customer Feedback (BF-05)** 

**Primary Module:** M5 \- Consolidated Checkout & Analytics

**Primary Actors / Systems:** Custmer, Receptionisot, HSWRMS, VNPay Payment Gateway

**Trigger:** Customer requests to check out from the resort.

**End Condition:** All outstanding charges are settled, checkout is completed, villa status is updated, and the Customer may submit a review/rating.

![][image7]

[Link Consolidated Checkout, Payment & Customer Feedback (BF-05)](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1m8wu78qEBwayMdWs2AXPqrX8UeDjeA-3&usp=chrome_ntp) 

### **2.6 System Administration, Permission & Management Monitoring (BF-06)** 

**Primary Module:** M6 \- System Administration & Permission Management

**Primary Actors / Systems:** Admin, Manager, HSWRMS

**Trigger:** Admin or Manager signs in to perform an authorized administrative or management operation.

**End Condition:** Authorized configuration changes are applied and audited, or requested management information is displayed/exported according to the user's permission level.

***![][image8][Link System Administration, Permission & Management Monitoring (BF-06)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/149C8upH_y8sEqsQnNOnGu373tmFx7sFt)***

## **4\. User Requirements**

### **4.1 Actors**

| \# | Actor | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Guest (Customer) | Registers/signs in, maintains health/diet profile, browses and books retreat packages, schedules spa, selects meals, views itinerary, pays and reviews the stay. |
| 2 | Receptionist | Handles arrivals, check-in/check-out, physical villa assignment/status, manual extra spa booking and consolidated invoice operations. |
| 3 | Spa Therapist / Yoga Instructor | Views assigned schedule and treatment-relevant health notes; records completed or no-show sessions. |
| 4 | F\&B Staff / Chef | Views aggregated meal requirements and relevant allergy/diet warnings; updates meal preparation status without unrelated medical data. |
| 5 | Admin | Manages staff accounts, master data, system settings, permissions, feature flags and security/audit administration. |
| 6 | Manager | Uses management dashboards/reports and approved read-only or restricted views; does not receive full Admin authority by default. |
| 7 | VNPay Payment Gateway | Processes retreat deposit and final checkout payment requests and returns payment results. |
| 8 | Calendar & Notification Services | Receives confirmed therapy/calendar synchronization requests and sends OTP/reminder notifications as required. |
| 9 | Identity Providers | Google Login and Facebook Login authenticate Guest through supported SSO flows. |

### **4.2 Use Cases (UC)**

| ID | Use Case | Feature | Use Case Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| UC01 | Register, Verify Email & Login | M1 Authentication & Health Profile | Guest creates an account, verifies email, signs in securely, or uses supported Google/Facebook SSO. |
| UC02 | Manage Dietary & Health Profile | M1 | Guest records dietary/allergy and physical treatment information with explicit consent. |
| UC03 | Manage Staff Accounts & Roles | M1 | Admin creates, assigns roles to, edits, or deactivates staff accounts. |
| UC04 | Manage Master Data | M1 | Admin manages Villa Categories, Spa Services and Retreat Packages using wellness terminology. |
| UC05 | Request Health Data Deletion | M1 | Guest requests deletion/anonymization of health and allergy data after retreat completion. |
| UC06 | Browse Retreat Packages | M2 Booking & Accommodation | Guest browses packages and filters by wellness goal. |
| UC07 | Book Retreat & Pay Deposit | M2 | Guest selects package/dates/villa type and pays deposit via VNPay. |
| UC08 | Check-In & Assign Villa | M2 | Receptionist verifies Guest, collects required residence information, and assigns a physical villa. |
| UC09 | Manage Villa Status | M2 | Receptionist manages Available/Occupied/Maintenance operational status. |
| UC10 | View Booking & Itinerary | M2 | Guest views booking details and itinerary timeline. |
| UC11 | Schedule Included Spa/Therapy Session | M3 Spa Scheduling | Guest selects date/time for an included session. |
| UC12 | Match Therapist & Treatment Room | M3 | A valid booking requires both an available Therapist and Treatment Room for the requested slot. |
| UC13 | View Therapist Schedule & Health Notes | M3 | Therapist views daily schedule and treatment-relevant health notes for assigned guests. |
| UC14 | Mark Session Completed / No-Show | M3 | Therapist records session outcome. |
| UC15 | Manually Book Extra Spa Service | M3 | Receptionist books an extra spa service and charges it to the villa folio. |
| UC16 | Pre-select Daily Meals | M4 Dietary F\&B | Guest selects meals from a menu filtered by allergy/diet profile. |
| UC17 | View Daily Meal Prep Dashboard | M4 | Chef/F\&B views aggregated meal orders and relevant allergy warnings. |
| UC18 | Update Meal Order Status | M4 | Chef/F\&B updates meal state from Preparing to Ready. |
| UC19 | Order Extra A-la-carte Item | M4 | Guest orders an extra item and charges it to the villa folio. |
| UC20 | Minimize Health Data for Chef | M4 | Only food-allergy/diet information required by F\&B is exposed; unrelated medical history is hidden. |
| UC21 | Generate Consolidated Invoice | M5 Checkout & Analytics | Receptionist aggregates package, spa and F\&B charges by Room\_Booking\_ID. |
| UC22 | Process Final Payment & Update Villa | M5 | Receptionist completes payment only after outstanding charges are cleared, then updates villa status. |
| UC23 | Submit Review & Rating | M5 | Guest submits a review after checkout. |
| UC24 | View Revenue Dashboard | M5 | Manager views revenue breakdown by Package, Spa and F\&B. |
| UC25 | Export Occupancy & Therapist Utilization | M5 | Manager exports occupancy and therapist utilization reports to Excel. |
| UC26 | Configure Business Parameters | M6 System Administration | Admin configures parameters such as refund percentage and cancellation window. |
| UC27 | Toggle Feature Flags | M6 | Admin enables/disables features by module. |
| UC28 | Configure Permission Matrix | M6 | Admin configures detailed permission rules by screen/role. |
| UC29 | Delegate Limited Admin Rights | M6 | Admin grants Manager a limited subset of administrative capabilities. |
| UC30 | View Sensitive-Data Audit Log | M6 | Admin reviews logged access to sensitive information. |
| UC31 | View System Overview Dashboard | M6 | Admin/Manager views a system-level operational overview according to granted access. |

#### ***b. Screen List***

| \# | Screen Name | Feature | Description |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | Public Landing | Common / M1-M2 | Public entry screen providing access to retreat packages, registration and login. |
| 2 | Customer Dashboard | M1 – Authentication \[Derived\] | Main post-login navigation screen for Customer, providing access to bookings, spa sessions, meals, profile and folio. |
| 3 | Register | M1 – Authentication  | Allows a new Customer to create an HSWRMS account using required personal and authentication information. |
| 4 | Email OTP Verification | M1 – Authentication  | Allows Customer to enter the OTP sent by email to verify the registered account. |
| 5 | Login | M1 – Authentication  | Allows users to sign in using email/password or initiate supported Google/Facebook SSO. |
| 6 | Password Reset | M1 – Authentication \[Derived\] | Allows a user to request and set a new password when login credentials are forgotten. |
| 7 | Account Settings | M1 – Authentication \[Derived\] | Allows an authenticated user to manage basic account and security settings, including password change. |
| 8 | Health & Dietary Profile | M1 – Health Profile  | Allows Customer to view, create and update allergy, dietary and treatment-relevant health information with explicit consent. |
| 9 | Health Data Deletion Request | M1 – Health Profile  | Allows Customer to request deletion or anonymization of eligible health and allergy data after retreat completion. |
| 10 | Staff Account List | M1 – Staff Account Management  | Allows Admin to view and search staff accounts and their assigned roles/status. |
| 11 | Staff Account Detail | M1 – Staff Account Management  | Allows Admin to create, edit, assign roles to or deactivate a staff account. |
| 12 | Master Data Management | M1 – Master Data  | Allows Admin to manage master data such as Villa Categories, Spa Services and Retreat Packages. |
| 13 | Retreat Package List | M2 – Retreat Booking  | Displays available retreat packages and allows Customer to filter packages by wellness goal or relevant criteria. |
| 14 | Retreat Package Detail | M2 – Retreat Booking  | Displays package description, included services, duration, villa options and information required before booking. |
| 15 | Retreat Booking Form | M2 – Retreat Booking  | Allows Customer to select retreat dates, package options and villa type and provide required booking information. |
| 16 | Booking Summary & Deposit | M2 – Retreat Booking  | Shows booking summary, deposit amount and payment information before redirecting the Customer to VNPay. |
| 17 | Deposit Payment Result | M2 – Retreat Booking  \[Derived\] | Displays the returned deposit payment result and confirmed booking information after VNPay processing. |
| 18 | My Bookings | M2 – Booking Management  | Displays the Customer's current and historical retreat bookings. |
| 19 | Booking Detail & Itinerary | M2 – Booking Management  | Displays booking status, retreat information, accommodation details and itinerary timeline. |
| 20 | Receptionist Dashboard | M2 – Front Desk \[Derived\] | Main operational navigation screen for Receptionist, including arrivals, check-in, villa operations and checkout access. |
| 21 | Daily Arrivals | M2 – Check-In  | Displays Customers expected to arrive and allows Receptionist to open the relevant booking for check-in. |
| 22 | Check-In & Residence Information | M2 – Check-In  | Allows Receptionist to verify the Customer and collect required identification and residence information for check-in. |
| 23 | Villa Assignment | M2 – Check-In  | Allows Receptionist to assign an available physical villa to a confirmed booking during check-in. |
| 24 | Villa Status Management | M2 – Accommodation Operations  | Allows Receptionist to view and update operational villa status such as Available, Occupied or Maintenance. |
| 25 | Spa Treatment List | M3 – Spa Scheduling  | Displays Spa/Therapy services available to the Customer, including services included in the retreat package. |
| 26 | Spa Session Booking | M3 – Spa Scheduling | Allows Customer to select a Spa/Therapy service, date and requested time slot. The system validates both Therapist and Treatment Room availability. |
| 27 | Available / Alternative Slot Selection | M3 – Spa Scheduling  | Displays available or alternative time slots when the originally requested Therapist and Treatment Room combination is unavailable. |
| 28 | Spa Booking Confirmation | M3 – Spa Scheduling  | Displays confirmed Spa/Therapy session information after both Therapist and Treatment Room have been successfully reserved. |
| 29 | My Spa Sessions | M3 – Spa Scheduling \[Derived\] | Displays upcoming and historical Spa/Therapy sessions belonging to the Customer. |
| 30 | Manual Extra Spa Booking | M3 – Extra Spa Service  | Allows Receptionist to select a Customer and manually book an extra Spa/Therapy service, with the charge posted to the Customer Folio. |
| 31 | Therapist Dashboard | M3 – Therapist Operations  \[Derived\] | Main screen for Spa Therapist/Yoga Instructor showing assigned work and access to the daily schedule. |
| 32 | Therapist Daily Schedule | M3 – Therapist Operations  | Displays Spa/Therapy sessions assigned to the logged-in Therapist for the selected working day. |
| 33 | Therapist Session Detail | M3 – Therapist Operations  | Displays assigned session details and only treatment-relevant health notes; allows Therapist to mark the session Completed or No-Show. |
| 34 | Dietary Menu | M4 – Dietary F\&B  | Displays meal options filtered according to the Customer's relevant allergy and dietary profile. |
| 35 | Daily Meal Selection | M4 – Dietary F\&B  | Allows Customer to pre-select meals for the applicable retreat day. |
| 36 | Extra A-la-carte Order | M4 – Extra F\&B  | Allows Customer to select and order additional F\&B items that are charged to the Customer Folio. |
| 37 | My Meal Plan / Orders | M4 – Dietary F\&B \[Derived\] | Allows Customer to view selected daily meals and submitted additional F\&B orders. |
| 38 | F\&B Dashboard | M4 – F\&B Operations  \[Derived\] | Main operational screen for Chef/F\&B Staff providing access to daily meal preparation requirements. |
| 39 | Daily Meal Prep List | M4 – F\&B Operations  | Displays aggregated meal orders and preparation workload for Chef/F\&B Staff. |
| 40 | Meal Order Detail | M4 – F\&B Operations  | Displays meal order details and only relevant allergy/dietary warnings; allows F\&B Staff to update status from Preparing to Ready. |
| 41 | Customer Folio & Consolidated Invoice | M5 – Checkout 1 | Displays consolidated Package, Spa and F\&B charges for the selected stay and identifies any outstanding amount. |
| 42 | Final Payment | M5 – Checkout 2 | Allows final payment to be initiated only when applicable charges have been consolidated and checkout requirements are satisfied. |
| 43 | Final Payment Result | M5 – Checkout  \[Derived\] | Displays the result returned from the payment process and indicates whether payment was successfully confirmed. |
| 44 | Checkout Confirmation | M5 – Checkout  | Displays successful checkout after payment is confirmed and the booking and villa operational statuses have been updated. |
| 45 | Review & Rating | M5 – Customer Feedback  | Allows Customer to submit a rating and review for a completed retreat stay, either from HSWRMS or an emailed review link. |
| 46 | Revenue Dashboard | M5 – Analytics  | Allows Manager to view revenue information and breakdowns across Retreat Package, Spa and F\&B services. |
| 47 | Occupancy Report | M5 – Analytics  | Allows Manager to view accommodation occupancy information and export permitted report data. |
| 48 | Therapist Utilization Report | M5 – Analytics  | Allows Manager to view Therapist utilization information and export permitted report data. |
| 49 | Admin Dashboard | M6 – System Administration \[Derived\] | Main administration navigation screen for Admin, providing access to configuration, permissions, security and audit functions. |
| 50 | Business Parameters | M6 – System Administration  | Allows Admin to configure system business parameters such as cancellation windows, refund percentages and other configurable rules. |
| 51 | Feature Flag Management | M6 – System Administration | Allows Admin to enable or disable supported system features or modules using feature flags. |
| 52 | Permission Matrix | M6 – Permission Management  | Allows Admin to configure detailed role-to-screen and role-to-function access permissions. |
| 53 | Limited Admin Rights Delegation | M6 – Permission Management | Allows Admin to grant or revoke a limited subset of administrative capabilities for Manager. |
| 54 | Sensitive Data Audit Log | M6 – Audit & Security | Allows Admin to review logged access and sensitive-data related activities for security and accountability. |
| 55 | Manager Dashboard | M6 – Management Monitoring \[Derived\] | Main navigation screen for Manager, providing access to authorized management dashboards, reports and system overview. |
| 56 | System Overview Dashboard | M6 – System Monitoring  | Displays a system-level operational overview to Admin or Manager according to granted permissions. |
